summary.text: STERLING PROCESSING AS is a private limited company registered in Randaberg, founded 2021-06-28. Sterling Processing AS processes and refines kveite (Greenland halibut), together with activities naturally connected to this. It was previously named STERLING WHITE HALIBUT PROCESSING AS until 2022-03-23. Its main industry code is 10.202: slaughtering of fish, crustaceans and molluscs. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 12 966 633 NOK and the annual result was -4 405 369 NOK; operating income was up from 9 033 778 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -4 938 239 NOK in 2024 to -4 405 369 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 8 494 744 NOK in 2024 to 10 589 375 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 9 on 2026-01-14 to 12 on 2026-07-16. The register's most recent update was on 2026-07-30 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
